{{Quote|I didn't want to be a soldier. I escaped.|The clone, to Jango Fett|<ref name="Blood Ties 2" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a '''clone''' of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] and was part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] being developed for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Having no desire to be a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]], the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] escaped from the planet to live a life of his own. He met and [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Connor Freeman's mother|woman]] and soon fathered a son, [[Connor Freeman]]. The three of them settled on the planet [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], feeling that it was dangerous to let the clone live because of the information he possessed regarding the clone [[Army/Legends|army]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] hired Jango Fett to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the clone, and Fett did so. Fett spared the clone's wife and son and even created an inheritance fund to support the child.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I didn't say anything to ''anyone''. I just wanted a ''life''!''"<br />"''You had one. It's ''over'' now.|The clone and Jango Fett|<ref name="Blood Ties 2" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] individual was one of the many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to serve in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] as [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. Unwilling to spend his life in service to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the clone escaped from Kamino in pursuit of a peaceful existence. He did not tell anyone about his origins and made a point to always wear a [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] in public in order to hide his resemblance to Fett. Eventually, the clone met and [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a [[Connor Freeman's mother|woman]], and the two had a son, whom they named [[Connor Freeman]]. By [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the family had settled in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Talos (spaceport)|Talos]] on the planet [[Atzerri/Legends|Atzerri]], taking care over the infant Connor.<ref name="Blood Ties 2" /> In 22 BBY, unbeknownst to the clone, he was targeted for [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]] by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], who had been secretly involved in the creation of the [[Army/Legends|army]] and who believed that the deserter was too dangerous to be left alive because of the information he possessed regarding the Kamino operation. Dooku hired Jango Fett himself to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the clone, although the Count did not reveal the true identity of his target to Fett.<ref name="Blood Ties 1">[[Blood Ties 1|''Blood Ties'' 1]]</ref>

[[File:Fett_clone_standoff.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The clone, at the mercy of Jango Fett]]

While he was inside his apartment in Talos, clad in his helmet, the deserter was nearly hit by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt fired through a [[Window/Legends|window]] by Jango's son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba]], who accompanied his [[Parent/Legends|father]] on the mission. The shot barely missed, the only damage being some scratches on the clone's armor from the window's shattered [[Glass/Legends|glass]], and the clone hid inside the apartment, waiting to confront his assassin. When the elder Fett burst in, the clone attacked him from behind, demanding to know who had sent the killer. In a brawl that followed, the clone tore off his opponent's helmet but was wounded in the chest when Fett fired his [[WESTAR-34 blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. As Fett prepared to fire a lethal shot, the clone recognized his [[Clone template/Legends|progenitor]] and removed his own helmet. Fett was surprised by the sight of his own face and hesitated to fire for a moment.<ref name="Blood Ties 1" />

The clone then tried to explain to Fett that he had only wanted to live a peaceful life, but Fett was unmoved by his words and shot the clone, killing him. As Fett prepared to leave the apartment, he discovered the clone's wife and son, who had been hiding during the entire fight. Seeing as the wife was baffled to discover that her husband's killer had the same face as the victim, indicating that she did not know anything about the clone army&mdash;and because killing the two was not in his contract&mdash;Fett spared their lives and left. His feelings stirred by the meeting with the clone and his family, Fett set up an inheritance fund shortly before the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]], during which he was killed. The fund provided Connor Freeman with small payments in [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] every [[Standard week/Legends|week]] since he was one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] old.<ref name="Blood Ties 2" />

Freeman eventually grew up and discovered that his father had been a clone and that he had been killed by Fett. He did not know who had set up the inheritance fund, believing that it had been his father.<ref name="Blood Ties 3">[[Blood Ties 3|''Blood Ties'' 3]]</ref> Seeing the money as the only legacy of his deceased parent, Freeman felt the need to make this legacy larger to make a dead man proud. To this end, he withdrew all the money from his fund and waged it all in a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game against the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tayand]]. Freeman won, but Tayand claimed that he had cheated and placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head.<ref name="Blood Ties 4">[[Blood Ties 4|''Blood Ties'' 4]]</ref> The bounty was accepted by several bounty hunters, one of them Boba Fett. This led to a series of events<ref name="Blood Ties 2" /> that culminated with the younger Fett rescuing Freeman from the other bounty hunters and killing Tayand, allowing Freeman to claim Tayand's treasures.<ref name="Blood Ties 4" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Can you really do it? Can you shoot ''yourself''?''"<br />"''Could ''you'' do it?''"<br />"''&hellip;no''."<br />"''That's because ''you're not me''.|The clone and Jango Fett, as the latter kills the former|<ref name="Blood Ties 2" />}}
A clone of Jango Fett, the individual had the same height of 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] as his genetic template.<ref name="Databank" /> He also had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and tan skin.<ref name="Blood Ties 2" /> Like all of Fett's clones, Connor Freeman's father was trained in the use of blasters, a skill that Connor also developed.<ref name="Blood Ties 4" /> The clone did not want to be a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] like the rest of his clone brethren, and he escaped from Kamino. In pursuit of normal life, he became a husband and a father. He tried to keep a low profile by wearing a helmet to hide his identity and did not tell anyone that he was a clone. When confronted with Fett on Atzerri, the clone tried to plead for his life and believed that he would not have killed his clone had he been in Fett's place. This proved to be the major differentiating factor between the clone and his genetic template, as Fett did not hesitate to kill the clone.<ref name="Blood Ties 2" />

==Behind the scenes==
This clone first appeared in the [[Blood Ties 1|first part]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Blood Ties]]'' comic series, written by [[Tom Taylor]], illustrated by [[Chris Scalf]],<ref name="Blood Ties 1" /> and published on [[August 25]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54015/star_wars_blood_ties_2010_1|text=Star Wars: Blood Ties (2010) #1}}</ref>
